worldcombat.skill.rest.summary: Sleeps on the spot and cannot act while asleep; a full sleep restores all missing health, cures every harmful status and grants a movement speed-up, while any damage wakes you early to pay out only the share you slept — statuses are still cured, but you are left slowed.
worldcombat.skill.rest.use.2: Return to the fight with a speed-up
worldcombat.skill.rest.description.0: Sleeps for %1$s; a full sleep restores %2$s of the missing health, and any damage wakes you early to pay out only the share you slept through.
worldcombat.skill.rest.description.1: A full sleep also grants %1$s of movement speed-up (+20%%); being woken early grants none and instead leaves you slowed for %2$s (reduced movement speed).
worldcombat.skill.rest.stance.deep: Deep sleep: the full duration, all missing health and Refreshed, with a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rest.stance.nap: Nap: about half the duration, about 60 percent of the healing and no Refreshed, for x0.8 cooldown and a shorter recovery.
worldcombat.skill.rest.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.rest.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rest.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rest.preference.shortN: On: about half the sleep, 60 percent of the healing and no Refreshed, at x0.8 cooldown and 2 ticks less recovery. Off: the full sleep and the speed-up.
worldcombat.skill.rest.preference.ai.hea: Below this health ratio the companion schedules Rest as a recovery step; lower endures longer, higher withdraws at the first wound.
worldcombat.skill.rest.preference.ai.saf: The companion treats Rest as a safe window only while no living enemy is within this distance; lower sleeps closer to the fight, higher withdraws farther first.
worldcombat.skill.rest.description.addit: It can only be used while wounded or carrying a status; whether you sleep through or are woken early, every harmful status is cured, while healing pays out by the share you slept.
